welcome.title: Know the risks of your AI system, and where they come from.
welcome.lead: Answer 24 questions about your system. Kindynos finds its risks in the seven domains of the MIT AI Risk Repository, says who or what causes each one, and gives you a report to keep.
welcome.questions_text: Your answers stay in this browser until you start the analysis.
welcome.taxonomy_text: 7 domains, 24 subdomains, and the causes of each risk: entity, intent and timing.
welcome.report_text: One HTML file with interactive charts, that opens offline.
welcome.name_hint: It becomes the title of the report, and stays on this computer.
welcome.language_legend: Language of the questionnaire and of the report
welcome.draft: {count} of {total} questions answered, kept in this browser.
welcome.start_over_question: Delete your answers and start again?
welcome.privacy_text: Your answers go to Gemini, Google's model, which writes the risks and the summary. A model on your computer labels their causes, and the expert rules run here too.
welcome.example_label: A risk as the report shows it
welcome.example_title: Generation of factually incorrect or misleading information

errors.other_required: Write what “Other” is, or untick it.
errors.followup_required: This question needs an answer too.

review.title: Review your answers
review.lead: Check what you wrote before the analysis. You can change any answer.
review.next_domain: Gemini writes the risks of each subdomain.
review.next_causes: A model on this computer labels their causes.
review.next_rules: Expert rules compute the score and the recommendations.
review.next_report: Gemini writes the summary, and your report is ready.
review.run_note: Two requests to Gemini. It takes a few minutes.
review.run_error: The analysis did not start: Kindynos does not answer. Check that it is running, then try again.
review.run_rejected: Some answers were not accepted. Check the questions marked “To complete”.

analysis.title: Analysing your system
analysis.lead: It takes a few minutes. You can close this page: the analysis goes on, and this address brings you back to it.
analysis.domain_text: Gemini writes the risks of each subdomain.
analysis.causes_text: The Laya model labels the entity, intent and timing of each risk, on this computer.
analysis.rules_text: Prolog rules compute the global score, the patterns and the recommendations.
analysis.report_text: Gemini writes the summary, and Kindynos builds the report.
analysis.error_quota: Gemini refused the request: the free quota of the day may be used up. Try again tomorrow, or with another key.
analysis.error_failed: Something went wrong during the analysis.
analysis.interrupted_text: The server stopped while the analysis was running. Your answers are still in this browser: you can start it again.
analysis.not_found_text: The address may be wrong, or the analysis was made on another computer.
analysis.offline: Kindynos does not answer: it may have stopped. This page keeps trying.

result.title: Your report is ready
result.no_results: The main results are not available, but the report is.
